title: Customer-configurable Redaction Templates and Retention SLA Translation Playbook
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers frequently submit non-bug data-governance requests asking for custom log redaction, retention translations from legal/contract SLAs into technical purge schedules, and export-safe audit views for compliance teams. Existing intake workflows capture priority and owner but lack a repeatable translation layer that turns a legal retention requirement into a deterministic Redwood configuration (retention windows, tiered storage, redact-before-export templates).

Goal: Produce a playbook and configuration primitives that PMs, Solutions Engineers, and CSMs can use to (1) intake customer governance requests, (2) map legal retention & PII handling requirements to a set of verified Redwood config templates, and (3) produce export-safe audit views and a validation checklist for Security/Legal reviews. The output should reduce time-to-resolution, lower review cycles, and enable a repeatable handoff to Eng and Support for implementation or productization.
acceptance_criteria: A clear intake form template (Confluence/triage UI) that captures legal retention clauses, jurisdictions, PII categories, export recipients, and encryption/KMS requirements
A decision matrix mapping common legal TTLs (e.g., 30d/90d/1y/7y) and data classes to Redwood retention config primitives, including tier transitions and purge semantics
A set of three reusable redaction templates (pattern-based, field-level, and tokenized K-anonymization) that Solutions Engineers can apply as a starting point
An export-safe view definition checklist and template that Security can sign off on (redaction applied, access controls verified, records of transformation stored)
Playbook includes handoff artifacts: sample Linear issue template, recommended labels, stakeholder list, and an 'eng implementation spec' stub that can be copy-pasted into ENG tickets
Measured outcome: reduce average intake-to-approved-config time from current baseline by 40% in pilot customers within two sprints
proposed_solution_summary: Create a triage playbook and a small library of 'Governance Config Templates' (retention-schemes + redaction profiles + export-view templates). Build a canonical intake form (Confluence + PM checklist) and a short runbook for Solutions Eng to execute a customer pilot. Deliverables: 1) Playbook doc, 2) 3 template configs in JSON examples, 3) Linear intake template and labels, 4) Security sign-off checklist, 5) Post-mortem template for pilot runs.
tradeoffs_and_risks: Trade-offs: shipping templated configs accelerates response but risks edge-case mismatches with customer contracts — mitigated by explicit 'contract exception' flags and a human legal review path. Risk: over-broad redaction templates may break observability; include sampling and staging flag to run in 'shadow purge' mode for 7-14 days before enforcement. Risk: increased workload on Security/Legal; include SLAs and a prioritization rubric to limit review volume.
